card.confirmSwitchOn: Switch the sauna entity on manually?
card.name: Sauna Suite
card.placeholder: Manual controls and monitoring only. No automatic heater regulation is implemented.
card.sliderUnavailable: Slider unavailable because min, max or step is missing.
card.trendDirectModesOnly: Trend is currently available only for direct sensor modes.
card.rgbUnsupportedLight: Configured light does not support RGB or HS color.

editor.cardNameDescription: Title shown in the card header.
editor.confirmSwitchOnDescription: Require a confirmation dialog before the manual power button turns on the configured entity.
editor.controlTemperatureModeDescription: Select which temperature is displayed as the main control temperature.
editor.mainSwitchEntityDescription: Manual power button entity. Supported domains: switch and input_boolean.
editor.nearTargetThresholdDescription: Degrees below target that should be treated as near target.
editor.showOutsideTemperatureDescription: Display the outside temperature when an entity is configured.
editor.showTemperatureTrendDescription: Load recent Recorder history for top, middle or bottom direct sensor modes.
editor.showTemperatureZonesDescription: Display top, middle and bottom sensor values.
editor.targetReachedToleranceDescription: Degrees around target that are considered target reached.
editor.targetTemperatureEntityDescription: Manual target setting entity. Supported domains: number and input_number.
editor.trendHistoryMinutesDescription: History window loaded from Recorder. Allowed range: 15 to 1440 minutes.
editor.trendRefreshMinutesDescription: How often the trend is refreshed. Allowed range: 1 to 60 minutes.
editor.weightBottomDescription: Weight for bottom sensor when weighted average is selected.
editor.weightMiddleDescription: Weight for middle sensor when weighted average is selected.
editor.weightTopDescription: Weight for top sensor when weighted average is selected.
editor.etaHistoryMinutesDescription: Recorder history window used for ETA and heating-rate calculation.
editor.etaMinimumSamplesDescription: Minimum valid Recorder samples required before ETA is calculated.
editor.fixedHeaterPowerKwDescription: Rated heater power used for ETA when no power sensor is configured.
editor.generalPowerSensorEntityDescription: Approximate total power sensor. W and kW units are supported.
editor.heaterRatedPowerKwDescription: Maximum sauna share used to cap the general power sensor estimate.
editor.heatingPowerModeDescription: Choose fixed heater power or an approximate general power sensor estimate.
editor.outsideTemperatureWeightDescription: Bounded ETA correction strength for outside temperature context.
editor.showEtaDescription: Display the deterministic heat-up estimate when enough Recorder data exists.
editor.showHeatingRateDescription: Display recent measured heating rate and effective heater power.
editor.showReadyTimeDescription: Display the expected clock time when ETA is available.
editor.rgbEnabledDescription: Use the configured light only for visual sauna status signaling.
editor.rgbLightEntityDescription: Home Assistant light entity with color support.
editor.rgbModeDescription: Choose continuous temperature gradient or ready-only signaling.
editor.rgbUpdateIntervalSecondsDescription: Minimum seconds between repeated RGB updates.
editor.rgbRestorePreviousStateDescription: Restore the light state captured before Sauna Suite takes control.
editor.rgbOnlyWhenSaunaOnDescription: Stop RGB signaling when the configured main switch is off.
editor.readySignalEnabledDescription: Signal when the sauna first reaches the target temperature.
editor.readySignalModeDescription: Hold, blink or pulse the configured ready color.
editor.readySignalColorDescription: Named color used for the ready signal.
editor.readySignalBrightnessDescription: Brightness percentage used by the ready signal.
editor.readySignalIntervalSecondsDescription: Seconds between blink or pulse steps. Minimum is one second.
editor.readySignalDurationSecondsDescription: How long one ready signal runs before stopping.
editor.readySignalRequiresAcknowledgementDescri: Show an acknowledgement button while the ready signal is active.
editor.readySignalRepeatDescription: Repeat the signal while the sauna remains ready and unacknowledged.
editor.readySignalRepeatIntervalSecondsDescript: Seconds to wait before repeating an unacknowledged ready signal.
editor.acknowledgementModeDescription: Choose whether the card, an external Home Assistant entity or both may acknowledge the ready event.
editor.acknowledgementEntityDescription: Optional input_button, button, input_boolean or binary_sensor used as an external acknowledgement control.
editor.acknowledgementResetInputBooleanDescript: Turn the configured input_boolean off after a successful acknowledgement.
editor.showAcknowledgeButtonDescription: Show the card acknowledgement action while a ready event is active.
editor.mediaNotificationEnabledDescription: Play a ready notification on a Home Assistant media_player entity.
editor.mediaPlayerEntityDescription: Home Assistant media_player entity used for ready notifications.
editor.mediaNotificationModeDescription: Use TTS speech or play a configured media source.
editor.mediaNotificationMessageDescription: Message spoken by TTS. Supports {temperature}, {target}, {eta} and {ready_time}.
editor.mediaNotificationMediaIdDescription: Media source, URL or media-source identifier for media mode.
editor.mediaNotificationVolumeDescription: Volume used for the ready notification, from 0.0 to 1.0.
editor.mediaNotificationRepeatDescription: Repeat while the current ready event remains active and unacknowledged.
editor.mediaNotificationStopOnAcknowledgeDescri: Attempt to stop playback when the ready event is acknowledged.
editor.mediaNotificationRestoreVolumeDescriptio: Restore the media-player volume captured before the notification.
editor.ttsEntityDescription: Home Assistant tts entity used with the standard tts.speak service.
editor.energyIntelligenceEnabledDescription: Show read-only PV, battery, grid and planning recommendations. No entities are controlled.
editor.pvPowerEntityDescription: Current PV production sensor. W and kW units are supported.
editor.pvPersistenceFactorDescription: Conservative fraction of current PV power used for near-term planning.
editor.batteryPowerEntityDescription: Signed battery power sensor. Configure the sign convention below.
editor.batteryPowerPositiveMeansDescription: How positive values from the battery power sensor should be interpreted.
editor.batteryCapacityKwhDescription: Usable nominal storage capacity used for planning estimates.
editor.batteryMinimumReservePercentDescription: Minimum SOC reserve that planning estimates must not consume.
editor.gridPowerEntityDescription: Signed grid power sensor. Configure the sign convention below.
editor.gridPowerPositiveMeansDescription: How positive values from the grid power sensor should be interpreted.
editor.saunaPowerEntityDescription: Optional current sauna load sensor. W and kW units are supported.
editor.saunaRatedPowerKwDescription: Fixed rated sauna-heater power used when no sauna load sensor is available.
editor.expectedSessionDurationMinutesDescriptio: Expected session duration used for approximate holding-temperature energy.
editor.plannedSaunaEnabledDescription: Calculate a read-only recommended start time for a desired ready time.
editor.plannedSaunaTimeDescription: Target ready time in HH:mm format, for example 19:00.
editor.plannedTargetTemperatureDescription: Optional planning target temperature. The configured target entity is used when empty.
editor.showEnergyRecommendationDescription: Display one concise deterministic energy-planning recommendation.
editor.showOptimalStartTimeDescription: Display the calculated heater start time. This does not start the sauna.
editor.showEstimatedEnergyNeedDescription: Display estimated heat-up plus session energy.
editor.showExpectedBatterySocDescription: Display estimated battery SOC after the sauna session.
editor.showPvContributionDescription: Display the simple PV planning contribution estimate.

energyRecommendations.start_now_for_target: For the desired ready time {ready}, the sauna should be started now.
energyRecommendations.pv_contribution: At the current PV yield, a large part of heating can be planned as solar.
energyRecommendations.battery_sufficient: The battery is expected to be sufficient without going below the configured reserve.
energyRecommendations.grid_needed: The sauna session is expected to need about {grid} from the grid.
energyRecommendations.missing_battery: Battery data is missing for a robust recommendation.
energyRecommendations.insufficient_data: More energy data is needed for a robust recommendation.
energyRecommendations.already_ready: The sauna is already at the planned target temperature.
energyRecommendations.target_time_missed: The desired ready time is no longer reachable.
